scope.coverage: Bounded review: ten same-class moved/renamed candidates, parent-designated cross-class same-basename cases, and two Druid Grasp examples. Not a semantic audit of all 172 routes.

accepted_986_map.note: Ten same-class moved assets are in the full inventory but absent from the accepted 986 route map. Cross-class same-name files in the map resolve to their own class routes only.

image_inventory.historical_identity: current related-source snapshot; no 2008 capture asserted

cross_class_review.evidence_note: Old Paladin covers melee-weapon and spell hit; later Rogue covers weapon/poison hit and Warrior covers melee hit. Later Rogue and Warrior on/off files are byte-identical to each other, which cannot identify missing old Paladin pixels.

cross_class_review.decision: Reject Warrior reuse; no Shaman image entity exists in this ZIP.
cross_class_review.evidence_note: Old Paladin increases shield damage absorbed; old Shaman increases block chance and amount blocked; current Warrior increases block chance and can generate Rage. Old images are unavailable for pixel comparison.

cross_class_review.decision: Do not map automatically; later description overlaps but original image is unknown.
cross_class_review.evidence_note: Both descriptions reduce spell damage. Current Priest image is a figure/prayer motif; no old Paladin target image is available to establish the same pixels.
Both are sword extra-attack procs, but later Warrior has a 6-second internal cooldown and 2–10% ranks versus old Rogue 1–5%. Later image is a glowing sword; original Rogue pixels are unknown.

cross_class_review.decision: Reject Shaman image; same-class Warrior moved candidate is listed above.
cross_class_review.evidence_note: Old/later Warrior descriptions match exactly. Later Shaman instead increases all-weapon damage; Shaman and Warrior images visibly differ (gauntlet/weapon versus sword).

visual_review.method: Review sheets enlarge cached 36px JPEGs with nearest-neighbor; source files were not modified or re-encoded.

observations.moved_same_class: All 20 selected on/off files decode as single-frame 36x36 JPEGs; ZIP payload matches private extraction and inventory hashes.
observations.precision: Later Rogue and Warrior Precision active/off files are byte-identical to each other; old Paladin pixels remain unknown.
observations.weapon_mastery: Later Shaman Weapon Mastery differs visually from the later Warrior Arms image and has a different effect description.
observations.shaman_earths_grasp: The only ZIP talent-image basename match for Druid Nature's Grasp wording is Shaman Earth's Grasp; its stone/earth-themed image and its class/ability do not establish a Druid Nature's Grasp mapping.

conclusion.recommended_use: If selected for page completeness, label as later CraftedRO WotLK 3.3.5a related-source art; do not describe it as a recovered 2008 original. Cross-class names remain unresolved/rejected for automatic reuse.
conclusion.additional_absent_same_class_candidate: The expected Shaman Shield Specialization on/off image paths are absent from ZIP, extraction, and inventory; current Shaman talent data also has no same-name assignment.
